recipe.visualDefinition: A centered close-up portrait of a young man against a dark, textured background, featuring bold, distressed condensed typography overlaid across the chest and integrated with vertical graphic lines.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the vibrant red garment and the dark, gritty background.
Interaction between the vertical white lines and the letterforms.
Textural unity between the background grain and the distressed effect on the type.
coreInvariants: Dark, mottled charcoal or brown background texture.
Thin vertical white lines intersecting the composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, head and shoulders filling the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and face, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes draw focus first, followed by the bold horizontal text block across the chest, then the vertical lines leading the eye up and down.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, heavy negative space surrounding the head to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (clothing) creating a focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white (typography and lines) for readability and graphic structure.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center (red) surrounded by low-value, desaturated dark tones.

letterConstructionRules: High x-height with minimal ascender/descender clearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed 'weathered' texture applied to the fill
Partial transparency allowing the shirt texture to show through

composition.scale: Large, spanning the width of the torso
composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated through texture and vertical line intersections

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for impact, paired with geometric graphic lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic condensed bold feel with high impact.
Clean, modern condensed structure that takes distressing well.
Square-ish condensed form matching the industrial/grunge vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a young man with dark hair wearing a bright red t-shirt, centered against a dark, gritty, textured charcoal wall. Apply a heavy film grain and slight vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of large, all-caps, extra-condensed sans-serif text across the chest. Apply a distressed, weathered texture to the text and place two thin vertical white lines that intersect the text and the background.

verificationChecks: Is the text condensed and all-caps?
Does the text have a weathered/grunge texture?
Are there thin vertical lines intersecting the composition?
Is the background dark and textured?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any specific logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Vertical lines do not obscure the subject's face.
The red of the shirt remains the primary color pop.
The overall image feels like a cohesive music-related graphic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + High Contrast Red/Dark + Condensed Distressed Type + Vertical Graphic Lines = Grungy Pop Aesthetic.
